rules.name: Community Spirit
rules.description: Any friendly Atlanta Camp model or Follower may spend 1SP to add 1Red to its Defense roll, as long as there is at least one friendly model in its Kill Zone.

rules.name: Prison Council
rules.description: If the group Leader has the Prison Advisor subtitle, all models in the group with the Prison Advisor subtitle may use Special Orders as if they were the Leader.

rules.name: Sound Tactics (Special Order)
rules.description: Rick may spend 1SP to nominate a friendly model in line of sight. That model activates immediately after Rick, in an exception to the usual order of play.

rules.name: Defensive Formation! (Special Order)
rules.description: While engaged, Rick may spend 1SP to add 1Red to his melee defense rolls and the melee defense rolls of friendly models within 3" for the rest of the round.

rules.name: Co-ordinated Charge
rules.description: When Rick uses a Charge! Special Order, target friendly models add 1Red to their melee attack rolls this round (Rick Grimes himself does not receive this bonus).

rules.name: Like Father Like Son
rules.description: If Rick Grimes is the Group Leader and still in play, Carl's Strategy Rating becomes X/1Red.

rules.name: Lucky Hat
rules.description: Carl Grimes only. Each time Carl is reduced to 0 health, roll 1Black. On a Shield, Carl is not removed, and is instantly restored to 1 Health point. On a blank, he is removed from play (or turned into a Prone Walker) as normal.

rules.name: Love Triangle
rules.description: When Rick and Lori Grimes are in the same group, measure the distance between them at the start of each of Shane's activations. If the distance between Shane and Lori is greater than the distance between Rick and Lori, Shane adds 1White to his attack rolls for the remainder of the round.

rules.name: Pinpoint Accuracy
rules.description: Andrea may spend 1SP when performing a ranged attack to add one automatic !.

rules.name: Tainted Meat!
rules.description: Dale can reroll failed Infection rolls.

rules.name: Crowd Control
rules.description: Glenn may perform the Shove! Action as a Free Action, even if he has already performed a Shove! Action this turn.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: When performing a melee attack across a barrier, exchange 1Red for 1Blue.

rules.name: Against the World
rules.description: When Maggie starts her activation within the Kill Zone of a friendly Glenn model, she may change her Character Type to Runner for the remainder of the round.

rules.name: Live By The Sword
rules.description: When performing a melee attack with the Sharp keyword, Michonne gains the Multiple Attacks (X) Keyword, where X is equal to the number of enemies she is currently engaged with.

rules.name: Block & Tackle
rules.description: When Tyreese successfully performs a Shove! Action, he may spend 1SP to automatically Shove! all other enemy models in contact, whether Walker or Survivor (but not Herds).

rules.name: Bring It
rules.description: While Tyreese is Outnumbered (either by Survivors or Walkers) he adds 1Red to his melee attack rolls.

rules.name: Arena Fighter
rules.description: When engaged with a single enemy, Michonne adds 1White to her melee attack roll.

rules.name: Single-Minded
rules.description:
At the start of the game choose one enemy Survivor, or one Static Objective. Each time Michonne activates and is not engaged, she must Move if possible towards the target. If she is
able to move into contact with the target, she must do so, but must always end the move closer to the target than she started.

rules.name: Blind Spot
rules.description: Carl discounts one ! from each ranged attack roll for the purposes of headshots.

rules.name: Lucky Hat
rules.description: Carl Grimes only. Each time Carl is reduced to 0 health, roll 1Black. On a Shield, Carl is not removed, and is instantly restored to 1 Health point. On a blank, he is removed from play (or turned into a Prone Walker) as normal.
